svg.text: Blank 240 x 150 mm from 2 mm 5052 sheet. Origin at the centre;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: X is positive toward the front, Y to the left; top face is the datum.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Frame holes 4.5 mm at 110 mm each side of centre, 65 mm each side (4).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rail holes 4.5 mm on lines 70 mm each side: at -93, -75, -30, 30, 90

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: mm along X on both lines; stop holes 4.5 mm at 95 mm, 55 mm each side.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Clinch nut holes 4.22 mm (14): lid flange at -60, 0, 60 mm, 50 each

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: side; 25 mm standoffs at -75 and 25 mm, 30 each side; 8 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: standoffs at -66 and 6 mm, 21 each side.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cable slot 12 x 24 mm from 70 to 82 mm along X, on the centre line:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: drill 6 mm in the corners, cut between, file square.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Press M3 clinch nuts in from the UNDERSIDE with a vice and two flat

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: plates; they must sit flush underneath (the shoe slides there).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: run a straight edge across the underside; nothing proud.
